decisions.reason: As a flagship transactional messaging service it is highly aligned with the firm's core cloud communication knowledge and R&D base, so despite its lower later visibility it is more likely to be retained and improved than withdrawn.

Document capture and recognition is adjacent rather than central to the firm's strongest messaging capabilities, and with weak later visibility the firm is likely to reallocate resources toward more core communication products and new developments.

Email and fax conversion still fits the firm's multichannel communications expertise and remains useful for German customers bridging regulated legacy and digital processes, making continuation somewhat more likely than withdrawal.

Although related to the firm's email security capabilities, the product's low later visibility and the firm's earlier willingness to rationalize security add-ons suggest it is more likely to be folded into broader services or discontinued as a standalone offer.
